distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: My current card was reissued, and the disputed transaction carried that same reissued-card reference.
clue_answer: the charge identifier matched the reissued card
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the card-history detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, there is a charge on my account that I did not make.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with that. Do you see the amount and date?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it is forty-two dollars from last Tuesday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The automated review accepts a dispute only when the charge's card identifier matches the current card record; otherwise it returns unmatched.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I checked which card identifier the charge used.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was the disputed charge tied to the same card identifier that is currently on file?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My current card was reissued, and the disputed transaction carried that same reissued-card reference.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the mailing address on the profile still correct?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that address is right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would a paper copy of the outcome be helpful?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, electronic is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you use the mobile application to check balances?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, almost every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was the physical card in your possession that day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it was in my wallet the whole time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you shared the number with any recurring service?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Only my usual streaming subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the contact number ending in six-one-eight still yours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that number is current.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Were there other unfamiliar amounts on the same statement?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, just that single one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did you travel outside your normal area recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I have been home all month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like alerts for every future transaction?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, please turn those on.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: File the disputed amount into the automated review queue.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait while that goes through.

user_action.observation: While you were unavailable, I updated the dispute so its card identifier matches the current card record.

dispute_status.not_filed: the disputed charge has not been submitted for review
dispute_status.under_review: the dispute is in the automated review process
dispute_status.returned_unmatched: review returned because the submitted details did not match the stored record

causal_alignment.misaligned: the charge identifier differs from the current card record
causal_alignment.aligned: the charge identifier matches the current card record

pre_gap_actions.description: File the disputed amount into the automated review queue.
Send out another physical card before reviewing the charge.
Freeze the whole account before the charge is examined.
Ask the merchant for paperwork before opening anything.
Close the request and tell the user to watch the balance.

post_gap_actions.description: Match the stored account identifiers against the charge before trying again.
Put the same amount through the automated queue again now.
Ask the merchant for paperwork about the amount.
Leave the existing entry alone and wait another interval.
Conclude that the completed operation succeeded, then close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Twenty-five minutes have passed and the dispute review finished, but its result code is hidden. Based on the card detail I gave earlier, what should happen next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Was the disputed charge tied to the same card identifier that is currently on file?
questions.gold_answer: the charge identifier matched the reissued card

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
